questions.stem: Translate the following into English: 她穿着一条红色的裙子。我喜欢蓝色。
markscheme: B1: 'She is wearing a red skirt' (她穿着一条红色的裙子)
B1: 'I like blue' (我喜欢蓝色)
questions.modelAnswer: 她穿着一条红色的裙子 = 'She is wearing a red skirt' — skirts take the measure word 条, a colour before a noun needs 的, and 着 marks the ongoing state of wearing. 我喜欢蓝色 = 'I like blue' — 喜欢 means 'to like' and 蓝色 is blue.

questions.stem: Complete each sentence with 穿 or 戴. (a) 他＿＿着一顶帽子。(He is wearing a hat.) (b) 她＿＿着一件外套。(She is wearing a coat.)
markscheme: B1: (a) 戴 — hats, glasses and jewellery are worn with 戴
B1: (b) 穿 — clothes, trousers, socks and shoes are worn with 穿
questions.modelAnswer: (a) 他戴着一顶帽子。— hats are put on with 戴, never 穿. (b) 她穿着一件外套。— clothes your body goes into take 穿. The split is the key rule: 穿 for clothes, trousers, socks and shoes; 戴 for hats, glasses, watches and jewellery.

questions.stem: Translate the following into English: 请问，车站在哪儿？银行在商店的左边。
markscheme: B1: 'Excuse me, where is the station?' (请问，车站在哪儿？)
B1: 'The bank is on the left of the shop' (银行在商店的左边)
questions.modelAnswer: 请问，车站在哪儿？= 'Excuse me, where is the station?' — 请问 politely opens a question to a stranger and 在哪儿 asks 'where is …'. 银行在商店的左边 = 'The bank is on the left of the shop' — the pattern A 在 B 的 + position word places A relative to B.

questions.stem: Translate the following into Chinese, using simplified characters: (a) I have caught a cold. (b) I also have a bit of a fever. (c) You should drink more water and rest more.
markscheme: B1: (a) 我感冒了。— 感冒 plus 了 marking the change of state
B1: (b) 我还有点儿发烧。— 还 for 'also' and 有点儿 for 'a bit'
B1: (c) 你应该多喝水，多休息。— 应该 before the verb and the 多 + verb advice pattern
questions.modelAnswer: (a) 我感冒了。(Wǒ gǎnmào le.) — 了 marks that the change has happened: 'I have caught a cold'. (b) 我还有点儿发烧。(Wǒ hái yǒudiǎnr fāshāo.) — 还 means 'also' and 有点儿 'a little'. (c) 你应该多喝水，多休息。(Nǐ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi.) — 应该 comes before the verb, and 多 + verb is the standard advice pattern (drink more water, rest more).

questions.stem:
Read the passage and answer the questions in English.

中国人最喜欢春节。过年的时候，我们一家人一起吃饺子。孩子拿红包，还可以看烟花。我最喜欢春节，因为可以拿红包。

(a) What do the family eat together at New Year? (b) What do children receive? (c) Why does the writer like Spring Festival best?
markscheme: B1: (a) dumplings (一起吃饺子)
B1: (b) red envelopes with lucky money (红包)
B1: (c) because they can get red envelopes (因为可以拿红包)
questions.modelAnswer: (a) The family eat dumplings together — 饺子 is the classic Spring Festival food. (b) Children receive red envelopes, 红包, with lucky money inside. (c) The writer likes Spring Festival best because they can get red envelopes — the reason follows 因为: 因为可以拿红包. (The passage also mentions that they can watch fireworks, 看烟花.)

questions.stem: Translate the following into English: 这条裤子比那条贵二十块。你要红的还是蓝的？
markscheme: B1: 'These trousers are twenty yuan more expensive than those' — 比…贵二十块
B1: 'Do you want the red one or the blue one?' — 还是 as 'or' in a question
questions.modelAnswer: 这条裤子比那条贵二十块 = 'These trousers are twenty yuan more expensive than those' — the pattern A 比 B + adjective + amount states the difference. 你要红的还是蓝的？= 'Do you want the red one or the blue one?' — 还是 means 'or' only inside questions, and 的 turns a colour into 'the … one'.

questions.stem: Write 3–5 sentences in Chinese about your school day. You must include: what time you get up; how you get to school; and one thing you do in the evening.
markscheme: B1: correct time-before-verb order with 点, e.g. 我每天七点起床
B1: a transport phrase used correctly, e.g. 我骑自行车上学 / 我坐公共汽车上学 / 我走路去学校
B1: an evening activity correctly expressed, e.g. 晚上我做作业 / 我十点睡觉
questions.modelAnswer: Example answer: 我每天七点起床。我骑自行车上学。下午四点放学。晚上我做作业，十点睡觉。(I get up at seven every day. I go to school by bike. School finishes at four in the afternoon. In the evening I do my homework and go to bed at ten.) Time words come before the verb in Chinese, and 骑 is used for a bicycle while 坐 is used for a bus or the metro.

questions.stem:
Read the passage and answer the questions in English.

从前，一个人养了十只羊。一天早上，他发现羊圈破了一个洞，一只羊没有了。邻居说：“快把洞补好！”他说：“羊已经丢了，还补什么？”第二天，又一只羊没有了。他很后悔，赶紧把羊圈修好了。从此，他的羊再也没有丢。

(a) What did the man discover one morning? (b) What did he do after he lost a second sheep? (c) This fable is the origin of the chengyu 亡羊补牢. What lesson does the chengyu teach?
markscheme: B1: (a) the sheep pen had a hole and one sheep was missing (羊圈破了一个洞，一只羊没有了)
B1: (b) he regretted it and quickly mended the pen — and never lost a sheep again (赶紧把羊圈修好了)
B1: (c) it is not too late to fix a problem after it appears / act promptly to stop further loss
questions.modelAnswer: (a) One morning he discovered that the sheep pen had a hole (羊圈破了一个洞) and that one sheep was gone. (b) After losing a second sheep he regretted his mistake (他很后悔) and quickly repaired the pen (赶紧把羊圈修好了); from then on he never lost another sheep (从此，他的羊再也没有丢). (c) 亡羊补牢 — literally 'mend the pen after losing a sheep' — teaches that it is not too late to fix a problem once it appears: acting promptly after a loss prevents further losses.
